text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana the list in our DM. I went through all six of Moss's shared notes and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk wasn't texting bay assignments for Doors 14–18. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was working.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet", which has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was sent up to second-tier support to test the scanner software.

I left out three numbers from Moss's Central handoff note (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) because they belong to Central team accounts, not QFL. I also skipped Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways," which is a different company and not a customer.

Moss hasn't posted anything in the two channels Moss and Dana share, so there were no Slack messages to check. I only read things Dana can see herself: public files and channels she belongs to.
